abstract: A caller posing as a police officer tells the victim they are linked to a bank debt used for drug-trafficking/money-laundering, interrogates them about family and assets (gold, savings books), and pressures them to disclose ID and transfer money for 'asset verification'.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and go to the local police station in person; Vietnamese police never investigate or demand transfers by phone

abstract: A caller posing as a police/commune officer says the victim must 'update' their citizen ID (CCCD) or VNeID account, guiding them to install an app or follow steps that hand over banking access; funds vanish after a few taps.
safe_verification_channel: CCCD/VNeID updates are done in person at the police office; never install apps or share codes from a call
